text:
Maya (marketing PM): Heads-up: HelioSync case study draft is ready for final review. I pasted the two quote versions we captured from the call. Need legal OK + client signoff by Friday noon to make next Tuesday's launch. Also coordinating a partner webinar for May 7 — who can own registration + landing page?

Jonah (producer): I can do the landing page + hero asset. Tentative schedule: hero quote by Wed EOD, transcript edits Thu AM, design polish Fri morning.

Priya (legal): Drop exact quote copy here. Any numerical claims need source docs or redlines. Also confirm we received a signed media release for the HelioSync logo.

Maya (marketing PM): Quote A and B below (A is longer).

Jonah (producer): ```Quote A: "With Redwood we saw a 3x throughput uplift for our serving pipeline and roughly 40% lower token spend — that let us push features live in days instead of weeks."```

Priya (legal): Flags: "3x" and "40%" are explicit. If we can't append the benchmark appendix, change to non-numeric language like "material throughput uplift" and "meaningful reduction in token cost." Also change "days instead of weeks" to "significantly faster rollouts."

Sam (growth): For webinar routing: create SDR tag helio_sync_launch and route demo signups to the helio_sdr queue. I'll build a two-email nurture and add a partner co-host CTA. Need UTM structure.

publishing-bot: Created ticket MKT-591: "HelioSync case study legal review & webinar setup" and assigned to Jonah.

Jonah (producer): Short hero: ```"HelioSync sped up model rollouts and lowered inference spend with Redwood."```

Priya (legal): Short hero OK but tighten language: replace "lowered inference spend" -> "reduced inference spend" and remove "sped up" -> "accelerated". Final hero: "HelioSync accelerated model rollouts and reduced inference spend with Redwood." Pending customer logo release and signed quote approval.

Maya (marketing PM): Great. @Sam please confirm SDR queue exists and add opt-in text for webinar signups. @Jonah I need the hero in the launch Figma file by Fri 9am. I'll ping the HelioSync contact for final approval now.

Sam (growth): Confirmed queue exists. Opt-in snippet: "By registering you consent to be contacted by Redwood and our partner." UTM: ?utm_source=webinar&utm_medium=partner&utm_campaign=helio_sync_launch

Jonah (producer): Figma: https://redwood.app/figma/helio-hero 98 I'll drop final assets.

Maya (marketing PM): Please react when you confirm on this thread. Priya, leave final legal OK here when done and I'll schedule the publish + webinar invites.

Priya (legal): Approved wording as edited. :white_check_mark: Waiting on customer signed media release.

Maya (marketing PM): Thanks all 94 I'll follow up with HelioSync and close the ticket once we have logo permission.
